mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 8.0% indicates labor market weakness, suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signal deteriorating labor market conditions, compressing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 700,000 units signals weak residential construction, reducing consumer confidence and business investment, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 700, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Month-over-month CPI (CPIAUCSL) acceleration above 0.2% signals rising inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations that depress equity valuations and predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL mo-mo change > 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high retail sales (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when RSAFS > 400,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals weak manufacturing output, reducing corporate production capacity and profit growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and rises in retail sales (RSAFS) signal a demand shift from housing to consumption, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST falls and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
